bagPolicy.summary: PNC Park enforces a clear bag policy to ensure guest safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are permitted.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets or zippers
prohibited: Bags larger than a small clutch
Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags may have exceptions.

parking.note: PNC Park is on Pittsburgh's North Shore with Pirates-operated lots (Gold, Red, General Robinson Garage) right by the ballpark plus downtown garages reachable via a walk over the Roberto Clemente Bridge. Prepaid parking is recommended, and Light Rail (the 'T') is free to the North Shore station.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in PNC Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: PNC Park offers a variety of food and beverage options including classic comfort foods with modern twists, such as Chicken Tenders & Fries, Cheeseburgers, and specialty hot dogs. Highlights include the Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry, with a range of local and popular beers available at the Beer Garden.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is available in all four (4) parking garages and two (2) surface parking lots (East Lot 2 & East Lot 3) on a first-come, first-served basis. Wheelchair accessible and semi-ambulatory seats with operable armrests are located in various sections on all ballpark levels.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in PNC Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at PNC Park. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at PNC Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
